title: Blair Master Series: Jared Hauser, oboe
description:
Join us for a Blair Master Series recital featuring internationally recognized oboist Jared Hauser on Thursday, October 1, 2026. A performer, recording artist, and champion of new music, Hauser will present a program highlighting the oboe’s extraordinary expressive range, lyricism, and versatility. Known for his engaging artistry and imaginative programming, he brings audiences a compelling blend of beloved repertoire and contemporary works.

⭐ Thursday, October 1, 2026, Turner Recital Hall, 7:30 p.m.
Tickets: $18.50

BlairTickets.com

title: Blair Jazz Combos
description:
Join us for an exhilarating celebration of jazz as Blair student ensembles share the stage with distinguished faculty artists and special guests from Nashville’s vibrant music community. From beloved jazz standards to original student compositions, each performance offers fresh perspectives, unexpected moments, and outstanding musicianship. Together, these concerts highlight the creativity, versatility, and virtuosity that define Blair’s nationally acclaimed jazz program.

⭐ Sunday, October 18, 2026, Turner Recital Hall, 7:30 p.m.
This is a free event.
